messages:
maya: getting reports that some customers didn't get pages for high-sev alerts. incident-bot shows deliveries but no on-call pages. anyone else seeing this?

devon: yep, seeing alert spike but no pages routed. customer-facing sevs affected. tagging infra.

incident-bot: ERROR failed to deliver page -> 429 rate_window_mismatch (pagerflow-webhook)

liam: @devon can you check the pagerflow -> incident-bot webhook queue? suspect rate-window config drift after last deploy.

devon: tailing webhook logs: 
```
2026-03-16T22:10:05Z POST /webhook -> 429 {"error":"rate_window_desync","retry_after":60}
2026-03-16T22:10:06Z POST /webhook -> 429 {"error":"rate_window_desync","retry_after":60}
```

ops-bot: paging oncall (sre-oncall) :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: I'm on it. switching to manual paging now — enabling SMS fallback and starting manual callouts to affected customers.

maya: creating temp channel #incidents-manual-reroute and updating runbook steps for manual escalate.

liam: found that `pf-worker-07` rate-window config shows `window_ms=10000` while incident-bot expects `window_ms=60000`. looks like a deploy config mismatch. restarting worker and flushing the webhook queue.

incident-bot: INFO reconnecting to pagerflow, retrying queued deliveries (queued=42)

sre-oncall: manual callouts sent to Customer A and Customer B. CX reported ~7m delay on their paging. logging customer impact.

devon: rolled back the unintended rate-window change in config repo and added a safety check to the deploy that validates `window_ms` against expected range.

liam: `pf-worker-07` restarted, backlog flushed, incident-bot deliveries returning 200s.

incident-bot: INFO resumed deliveries, queued=0

maya: mitigation checklist: restart worker, manual SMS fallback, temp channel, customer notifications. opening P1 incident ticket and will write up postmortem.

devon: follow-ups: add alert for 429 spikes `alert(pagerflow_webhook_429 > 5/min)`, add automated fallback to SMS after 30s of 429s, and add integration test that verifies window_ms parity.

sre-oncall: leaving handoff notes in #oncall-rotation for next shift. @liam will take postmortem lead.

liam: taking postmortem. already captured logs and timeline. will draft actions and PRs.

ops-bot: created incident ticket INC-2026-318 -> https://tracker.redwood.example/INC-2026-318

maya: adding runbook change + deploy guard as blockers for closing incident. setting 72h follow-up.

devon: assigning myself to the config PR and the alert rule.

sre-oncall: handoff complete, leaving channel.

end
